payload.explanation: The business UPDATE (session_b7a9278f357f) is blocked on a transactionid lock by session_58160c81992d, an idle-in-transaction session holding the row lock with no upstream blocker (report_aecba3333ce7). The state report confirms session_58160c81992d is project-owned and eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session has no allowed actions and must not be touched (report_fed19254fc46). Rolling back the blocker releases the lock, allowing the business request to complete; other causes (redundant index, large data) are ruled out by the diagnostic report.
